training.citation: Pimentel et al., Towards a Robust Estimation of Respiratory Rate from Pulse Oximeters, IEEE TBME 64(8), 1914–1923, DOI 10.1109/TBME.2016.2613124
training.selectionCriterion: minimum validation MSE on disjoint subjects

limitations: Trained on hospital pulse-oximeter PPG, not phone-camera PPG
Single ECG lead estimated in relative units; electrical activity is not measured
Subject-disjoint evaluation is not an external clinical study
